verdict.rationale: Apify's SDK documents a SessionPool class that manages proxy IP rotation together with cookies and other per-session settings. That implies each session keeps a consistent identity (IP plus cookies) across its requests. Proxy management docs confirm that Apify Proxy or custom proxies can be used underneath. Missing for 10: an explicit description of passing a session identifier to pin requests to the same proxy IP, details on sticky-session duration and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
